who.value: Buyer or seller with active chats

job.value: Read and reply to chats, including responding to an offer

arrivedFrom.value: The chat icon in the top nav

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Inbox' with '3 unread chats', a chat list and an open conversation is instantly recognisable.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Accept offer' button in the item bar above the thread is the strongest control on screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Accept offer' and 'Decline offer' are clear, but the list header has three unlabelled icons (search, a stacked-check icon, ⋮) and an 'Inbox ⌄' dropdown whose options aren't hinted.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Professional Seller', 'Offered you S$1' and 'Promotions' are familiar terms.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Accept or decline an offer whose amount is shown right beside the buttons.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The seller summary ('Professional Seller', '5 years on Carousell') is brief and the ⋮ menu holds the rest.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Chat list, thread and offer bar all serve chatting.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Chat rows and the offer bar carry it; the long message bubble is chat content, not interface copy.
